svg.title: EmberTail record so far
svg.desc: 200,000+ money checks run, each graded against the ledger (line: money checks run, cumulative by day, 5 to 16 Oct 2026). 9,000+ scenario runs across 1,700+ recorded test runs. 30+ projects tested: agents, wallets, LLM gateways, payment SDKs. 25+ confirmed findings, reproduced on the projects' published code.
